steps.name: gcr.io/cloud-builders/docker
args: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import fs from 'node:fs'; assert.equal(process.versions.node,'26.13.1'); assert.equal(process.platform,'linux'); assert.equal(process.arch,'x64'); assert.notEqual(process.getuid(),0); for (const [name,version] of [['near-api-js','7.4.0'],['@google-cloud/firestore','9.4.1']]) { assert.equal(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/app/node_modules/'+name+'/package.json')).version,version); await import(name); } for (const p of ['/app/.hermes','/app/target','/app/qualification','/app/src/server/orders.mjs','/app/src/server/app.mjs']) assert.equal(fs.existsSync(p),false); console.log('LINUX_AMD64_NODE_26_13_1_PRODUCTION_SDK_IMPORTS_OK_NOT_LIVE_READINESS');

steps.name: gcr.io/cloud-builders/docker
args: set +e; result=$$(docker run --rm --network=none --read-only --cap-drop=ALL europe-west1-docker.pkg.dev/$PROJECT_ID/haldir-preview/auth-preview:$BUILD_ID 2>&1); code=$$?; set -e; test "$$code" -ne 0; test "$$result" = EXACT_HTTPS_ORIGIN_REQUIRED; printf '%s\n' UNCONFIGURED_BOOTSTRAP_REJECTED_NOT_CONFIGURED_STARTUP;
